answer: IBRANCE (palbociclib) is approved for HR+/HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer in several settings: (1) with an aromatase inhibitor (e.g., letrozole) as initial endocrine-based therapy in postmenopausal women/men (originally accelerated approval based on PFS, contingent on confirmatory trial verification); (2) with fulvestrant after disease progression on prior endocrine therapy; (3) with inavolisib and fulvestrant for PIK3CA-mutated disease progressing after adjuvant endocrine therapy; and (4) as maintenance with trastuzumab ± pertuzumab and endocrine therapy for HER2+ disease. It is also approved for men with HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer. For full eligibility criteria, please consult the current label or Medical Information.
